title: Input paths still contain panic-prone unwraps
plain: Some input or state paths may panic instead of returning a controlled failure.
verify_by: Exercise flagged paths with missing and malformed values and confirm an error is returned.
evidence: The scanner found unwrap calls in input-handling code; each call needs a focused check.
correction: Replace unsafe unwraps with explicit error propagation where input is untrusted.
test_plan: Run targeted failure cases and the existing Rust test suite.

title: Numeric conversions may silently lose values
plain: Some numeric conversions may truncate or overflow without a user-visible error.
verify_by: Exercise boundary values and confirm invalid conversions fail clearly.
evidence: The scanner found lossy casts in shipped Rust code; boundary behavior needs confirmation.
correction: Use checked conversions or explicit range handling.
test_plan: Run boundary-value tests for each affected path.

title: Some operation failures may be ignored
plain: Ignored results can make Atlas report progress when an operation actually failed.
verify_by: Force the flagged operation to fail and confirm the failure reaches status and logs.
evidence: The scanner found ignored results in shipped Rust code.
correction: Handle or explicitly document every result according to the operation contract.
test_plan: Run forced-failure checks for affected operations.

title: State imports may accept unknown fields silently
plain: Persisted state may load while ignoring fields it does not understand, hiding corruption or version drift.
verify_by: Load state containing an unknown field and confirm the chosen compatibility behavior is explicit.
evidence: The scanner found many deserializers without an explicit unknown-field policy.
correction: Choose and test strict rejection or deliberate migration handling.
test_plan: Run state compatibility tests with unknown and missing fields.

title: Missing state can fall back to defaults without clear status
plain: A missing or unreadable state file may be treated as a fresh default, risking silent loss of continuity.
verify_by: Remove or corrupt state and confirm Atlas reports the condition and preserves recoverability.
evidence: The scanner found defaulting state reads in shipped Rust code.
correction: Surface the read failure and require an explicit recovery path.
test_plan: Run missing, corrupt, and permission-denied state checks.
